reviews.title: Great app, (+user tip)
reviews.text:
Update: Settings>Notifications>Alarm Warning - Toggle indicating either enabled or disabled. When I exit the app while my iPhone ported want my phone on silent, the annoying, idls ports mcompletely unnecessary notifications are displayed despite having clearly indicated user choice them disabled.

I’ve been using this alarm app for years. It’s a keeper for sure. Love the graphics and the functionality is exactly as it should be. It’s great waking up to a custom playlist preselected for a happy yet energizing start to the world. Small annoyance: At one point the programmers decided to add a notification. Every time the app is closed, there is an immediate notification informing of when the next alarm will occur or if you have elected to turn off all alarms (say you happen to wake up before it goes off), then it will state no alarm set. This is annoying. The user clearly knows what they’ve chosen to do. Perhaps one person out there might like this, but I honestly don’t think the majority of users need this. I find it annoying because it’s like: YES, I KNOW WHAT I JUST DID! LOL 😅 At one point the programmers must have realized or (more likely) were informed of user objection to this. Within the app, the first item is notifications. The very first toggle is in fact “Next Alarm Time Notification”. This SHOULD do exactly what I want, but unfortunately it doesn’t work. The app still does it regardless whether this is on or off 👎 Work around: Go into iPhone settings, Notifications, Alarm Clock. **Keep Allow Notifications toggle turned on** If you disable this, the app will not sound (specifically I believe it’s if the app is closed). Instead below, uncheck your choices of the three Alerts: Lock Screen, Notification Center & Banners. IMO as exampled above, it’s the banners that really annoyed me the most when they popped up immediately after closing the app. So, wish the settings were slightly better but overall I will definitely continue to stick to this app and highly recommend it to any and all iPhone users!

reviews.title: Fav. For Years!  Now Broken!
reviews.text:
I have used and LOVED this app for years!  It has been my constant companion!  But it recently stopped working!  So sad!  It started doing super strange things, like: 
 - Alarming for no reason; no alarm set for the time it alarms - Using a different song than the one set up - Alarming and not allowing me to snooze or stop the alarm.  
The alarms set do work, if the clock is open on the main screen.  If the clock is closed it will still alert (as before) it just won’t lat me snooze it.  And then it continues to alert until I go in and disable that alarm.  
In all fairness: I have used this clock a TON for years!  And I was not charged a penny.  Happy to send some love if it can be fixed!  Sad it isn’t working because it has been a trooper!  Sad to see it stop working normal!  Thank you for the app!  Hope you can fix it!
